payload.title: PaMoDaCo: Contextualizing a downcore record in model-space
payload.description: This notebook integrates multiple paleoclimate datasets to provide context for downcore records in model-space, focusing on the abiotic component of radiocarbon data from iTRACE simulations. It compares model outputs with observational datasets such as Intcal20 and Marine20, and includes plotting calibration curves and comparing them with data from Marchitto et al., 2007.
